_comment_1: router_model_map: maps the trained-panel model names (in the shipped latent_factor_artefacts.pkl's available_models) to LRM's cloud-model / local-model aliases.
_comment_2: Panel: ['Qwen3.5-4B', 'Qwen3.5-9B', 'cloud', 'qwen3-coder-next', 'qwen3.6-35b']. The four qwen* labels are local SKUs; 'cloud' is the cloud-side panel slot. Keys MUST match panel names exactly (case-sensitive) - otherwise the adapter returns RouterFailure('router_predicted_unmapped').
